original_query: Which factor has the weakest influence on a buyer's consideration list?

summaries.found_via_query: factors influencing buyer consideration list weakest influence
summaries.summary: The infographic highlights key influencers on a buyer's consideration list for adding a vehicle, with TV ads having the strongest sway at 70% and reviews on vehicle sites at 80%. The weakest influence is 'What I hear on the radio' at 33%, which is positioned farthest from 'Strong Influence' on the scale. Other factors include online video ads (36%), social media likes/tweets (25%), and search engine results (55%).
key_facts: TV ads have the strongest influence at 70%
Reviews on vehicle review sites have the second strongest influence at 80%
What I hear on the radio has the weakest influence at 33%
Likes/tweets by auto manufacturers on social media have the lowest influence at 25%
visible_text: KEY INFLUENCERS ON THE SHORT LIST: TV is the Media with the Most Sway on a Buyer's Consideration List
What has the strongest influence on your decision to add a vehicle to your consideration list? (A25-54) (Top 3 box agree)
33% What I hear on the radio
25% Likes / tweets by auto manufacturer on social media
Source: CAB Automotive Buyers Study, Dec. 2011
